maya: CS flag: tenants hitting v1 after deprec prompt. Looks like some clients drop x-api-version on modal-confirm. Any quick mitigation?
sanjay: Logs: second requests often lack header and have same x-client-id within 3s. We can either change UX or be smarter at routing.
elena: Quick UX: change modal action to 'Continue (preserve headers)' instead of 'Retry'. I can ship copy+toggle in 15m.
ben: Runtime: propose a small 'keepalive' routing rule: if header missing AND recent request with same client id within N secs -> prefer v2 and tag request with X-Compat-Method: keepalive. Gate via FF. Pseudocode:
```
if missing(x-api-version) and recent_same_request(client_id, 5s):
  route = prefer(v2)
  set_header('X-Compat-Method','keepalive')
  set_header('X-Invoice-Tag','compat-keep')
  sample_bodies=0.2%
```
ben: We'll FF to 10 canary tenants first.
maya: Billing: zero-rate requests with invoice_tag=compat-keep for 14 days, then reconcile. Provide a report for CS.
elena: Console: add tenant-level numeric 'keepalive window' under Routing->Compatibility (default 0). Also add org-wide emergency flip.
sanjay: Observability: add metrics compat_keep_hits, v1_switchbacks and an alert: compat_keep_hits > 0.5% of traffic or v2_p95_increase > 150ms -> kill FF.
ops-bot: feature_flag created: compat_keepalive_by_ben at 1812345720
maya: Plan owners: Elena UI, Ben runtime, Sanjay metrics, Maya CS coord, Billing team sets credit policy. Rollout today 17:00-18:30 PT, canary first. Keep notes short in the canary channel.
elena: flipping modal copy to 'preserve headers' now.
ben: will open FF PR and instrument headers.
maya: thanks. We'll follow up with a one-paragraph customer note if we flip org-wide.
